title: Farm Real Estate Loans Fee Schedule Note — Late-Charge Percentage by Payment Record
content:
The late-charge percentage for an installment of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage follows the loan's record: when no late charge was assessed on the loan in the last 36 months and the loan was at least 24 months old on the installment's due date, the percentage is 3.0; when two or more late charges were assessed in those 36 months, it is 5.0; otherwise it is the product's late-charge percentage.

**What the records show.** The late charges assessed on the loan (fee entries marked as a late charge) dated in the last 36 months, and the loan's age in months from its closing date to the due date of the installment.

## Every combination

| Late charges assessed in the last 36 months | Loan age at the due date | Late-charge percentage |
|---|---|---|
| none | 24 months or more | 3.0 |
| none | less than 24 months | the product's late-charge percentage |
| exactly one | any | the product's late-charge percentage |
| two or more | any | 5.0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical loans)

- No late charge in 36 months, loan exactly 24 months old at the due date: 3.0. The same loan at 23 months: the product's late-charge percentage.
- Two late charges, one assessed 20 months ago and one 37 months ago: only one falls in the last 36 months, so the product's late-charge percentage applies. Had both been within 36 months: 5.0.
